article.story: ORLANDO, Fla. -- — King Grace scored 19 points off the bench, and RJ Johnson added 18 as Mississippi State rallied in the second half to hand UCF its first loss of the season, 86-83, on Tuesday night. The Bulldogs (4-1) trailed 42-37 at halftime but tied the game at 44 on Johnson’s 3-pointer with 18:28 remaining. Mississippi State then took control with a 13-3 run over 3:01, building a 57-51 lead with 14:02 left. Tristan Reed and Johnson scored during the stretch, and Josh Hubbard later hit a 3-pointer to push the advantage to 80-74 with 3:55 remaining. UCF (4-1) closed within 82-81 on two Dior Johnson free throws with 43 seconds left. Grace made two free throws with 8 seconds remaining to make it 84-81. Arturo Dean answered with two free throws for UCF, but Tajuan Simpkins hit two more with 5 seconds left before Dean missed a tying 3-pointer at the buzzer. Grace went 14 for 14 at the free-throw line and added four rebounds. Reed finished with 16 points and 11 rebounds off the bench, while Johnson had seven rebounds and five assists. Dior Johnson led UCF with 26 points. Dean added 18, and Isaiah Malone scored 14. Mississippi State outrebounded UCF 43-23, including a 17-6 advantage on the offensive glass. Up next UCF: At No. 15 Vanderbilt on Friday.
